## Summary

The **Phase-0 capstone** (ticket `docs/tickets/16_P0.15__phase0-integration-and-exit.md`): it verifies the *composition*, not new features, and produces the **G1 exit readout**. Every prior P0.x ticket deferred its live leg on **H0** (no deployed GCP `dev`, no metered Anthropic API in the build env), so this PR proves the whole Phase-0 system **deterministically in-process** and states — honestly — which half of the §17 exit criterion is met and which awaits the `dev` deploy.

**G1 is NOT flagged "pass".** The composition is proven and the pilot wave is fully met; the live three-project `dev` runs + instrumented cost runs remain H0-deferred (new rows D-P0.15-1..5). See `docs/phase0-exit-readout.md`.

## What changed

- **`integration/` (`@rhema/integration-tests`)** — the ledger **G21** FakeEngine integration suite: composes the **real api HTTP routes + worker handlers + FakeEngine + PGlite** for all five scenarios (gates, orphan resume, cancel, cap exhaustion, stale task), plus `assessPhase0ExitForRun` (the AC1–AC5 asserters over a delivered run's rows). `server-postgres.test.ts` runs the migrations + real-project seed against a server Postgres (**closes D-P0.02-1**, verified against real PG16).
- **CI `integration` job** — was a placeholder `echo`; now `turbo build` → `vitest run integration` (server-Postgres via `DATABASE_URL`→`postgres:16`) → the two-uid privsep-Docker leg (**closes D-P0.06-2 / D-P0.08-3**).
- **`packages/orchestrator/usage-crosscheck.ts`** — §12.7 cross-check-1: `proxyVsSdkCrossCheck` (proxy-metered vs SDK-reported ±2%, alert >5%).
- **`packages/benchmark-runner/pilot.ts`** (+ migration `0015`) — REQ-EVAL-5: `estimatePilotPower` wires the wave report's per-draft paired recalls → σ_d → `fixSampleSize`; `recordPilotPower` persists it. Demonstrated end-to-end on the dev set (`pilot-wave.e2e.test.ts`).
- **`packages/protocols/estimator.ts`** — §16.3 #1 instrumented-cost machinery: `provisional`→measured with a version + `calibrationScale`, §6.1 `RIGOR_MULTIPLIERS`, an `estimateCredits` consumer, and `foldInstrumentedRun`. Ships **provisional** (measured values = H0).
- **`packages/benchmark/fixture-floors.ts` + `scripts/nightly-golden.mjs` + `scripts/lib/parser-fixture-growth.mjs`** — §13.5 nightly golden runner + REQ-ARCH-36/REQ-EVAL-17 promotion floor gate + the green-dossier→parser-fixture growth step.
- **`docs/phase0-exit-readout.md`** — the G1 exit readout. **`DEFERRALS.md`** — closes D-P0.02-1/D-P0.06-2/D-P0.08-3, advances D-P0.13-4, appends D-P0.15-1..5.

## Design decisions

- The live half of the §17 criterion is genuinely blocked on the `dev` deploy; rather than fake it, this PR builds + tests every asserter that will read the live rows and defers the execution explicitly. The readout is the honest input to the operator's G1 decision.
- The estimator ships `provisional: true` because no real proxy-metered run exists yet; `foldInstrumentedRun` is the mechanism that flips it once a live run lands (demonstrated on a fixture).

## Verification

- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → **99/99 green**.
- `pnpm test` → **997 pass, 1 skipped** (server-postgres without `DATABASE_URL`); +60 tests over baseline.
- D-P0.02-1 **verified against a real `postgres:16` container** (all 15 migrations + real-project seed).
- Nightly runner CLI: no-manifest → exit 0; below-floor → exit 1; `--grow` rejects an invalid sidecar.
